constructor.details: Initializes the factory, setting the oracle, treasury, and deployer as owner.

params._oracle: The address of the PythiaOracle contract.
params._treasury: The address of the protocol treasury.

createMarket(string,uint256,uint256).details: Deploys a new PredictionMarket instance. Passes any provided msg.value to the market as initial seed liquidity. Only callable by the oracle or the owner of the factory.

params.deadline: The unix timestamp deadline for placing bets.
params.question: The question being predicted.
params.strikePrice: The strike price for price-based markets.

getMarketCount().details: Returns the total number of markets created by the factory.

returns._0: The count of all deployed markets.

getMarkets().details: Returns an array of all created market addresses.

returns._0: An array of PredictionMarket contract addresses.
